payload.body: hv's ruling (decision 3 on hv's board): the 0.1.9 cut takes route C past devbin 0348. Just before the cut hv runs bin/devbin install and bin/devbin use opt, so doctor passes with the link on opt; after the publish, brew upgrade ccusage, then bin/devbin use brew and T10's check. No devbin 0.1.24 comes before the cut, so LICENSE stays out of 0.1.9's archives and your hold 9 waits for a later devbin; hold 10 now waits only for the cut itself. Also from hv: engineering04 stays a profile, and ccusage must work for any Claude account and show whatever it can for that type. So when you close ISSUE:0003, its last acceptance line reads each account once in Claude Usage, not exactly five accounts. vc writes the cut's steps for hv together with WP06's rollout.
